package internalapi

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
)

type courseAssignerHTTPStub struct{ input studentuc.AssignCourseInput }

func (stub *courseAssignerHTTPStub) Handle(
	_ context.Context,
	input studentuc.AssignCourseInput,
) (domain.StudentCourseAssignment, bool, error) {
	stub.input = input
	return domain.StudentCourseAssignment{}, false, nil
}

type learningPathHTTPStub struct {
	input studentuc.ReplaceLearningPathInput
}

type learningPathCompletionHTTPStub struct {
	input studentuc.CompleteLearningPathInput
}

func (stub *learningPathCompletionHTTPStub) Handle(
	_ context.Context,
	input studentuc.CompleteLearningPathInput,
) (domain.StudentLearningPath, error) {
	stub.input = input
	return domain.StudentLearningPath{}, nil
}

func (stub *learningPathHTTPStub) Handle(
	_ context.Context,
	input studentuc.ReplaceLearningPathInput,
) (domain.StudentLearningPath, error) {
	stub.input = input
	return domain.StudentLearningPath{}, nil
}

func TestAssignCourseRequiresDedicatedPlannerToken(t *testing.T) {
	assigner := &courseAssignerHTTPStub{}
	handler := &Handler{CourseAssignments: assigner}
	router := NewRouter(handler, "general-internal-token", "planner-only-token")
	path := "/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/courses/" +
		"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222/assignment"
	body := `{"planning_request_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","assigned_by":"learning_planner"}`

	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name   string
		token  string
		status int
	}{
		{name: "general internal token", token: "general-internal-token", status: http.StatusForbidden},
		{name: "planner token", token: "planner-only-token", status: http.StatusNoContent},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPut, path, strings.NewReader(body))
			request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", testCase.token)
			request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444")
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
			if response.Code != testCase.status {
				t.Fatalf("status=%d want=%d body=%s", response.Code, testCase.status, response.Body.String())
			}
		})
	}
	if assigner.input.AssignedBy != domain.CourseAssignmentSourceLearningPlanner ||
		assigner.input.IdempotencyKey != "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected command input: %#v", assigner.input)
	}
}

func TestReplaceLearningPathRequiresDedicatedPlannerToken(t *testing.T) {
	paths := &learningPathHTTPStub{}
	handler := &Handler{CourseAssignments: &courseAssignerHTTPStub{}, LearningPaths: paths}
	router := NewRouter(handler, "general-internal-token", "planner-only-token")
	path := "/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/learning-path"
	body := `{
      "course_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
      "goal_code":"go.backend",
      "course_fingerprint":"fingerprint-v1",
      "planner_policy_version":"course-planner-v1",
      "reason_code":"initial_plan",
      "reason_summary":"Build a Go API",
      "expected_version":0,
      "items":[{"reference_type":"lesson","reference_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","position":0,"status":"READY","targets":[{"type":"concept","key":"go.http","version":"v1"}],"reason_code":"first_current_gap"}]
    }`

	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name   string
		token  string
		status int
	}{
		{name: "general internal token", token: "general-internal-token", status: http.StatusForbidden},
		{name: "planner token", token: "planner-only-token", status: http.StatusOK},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPut, path, strings.NewReader(body))
			request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", testCase.token)
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
			if response.Code != testCase.status {
				t.Fatalf("status=%d want=%d body=%s", response.Code, testCase.status, response.Body.String())
			}
		})
	}
	if paths.input.StudentID != "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111" || paths.input.GoalCode != "go.backend" ||
		paths.input.CurriculumRevision != "fingerprint-v1" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected path command: %#v", paths.input)
	}
}

func TestReplaceLearningPathForwardsIdempotentStudentAllocationKeys(t *testing.T) {
	paths := &learningPathHTTPStub{}
	router := NewRouter(&Handler{LearningPaths: paths}, "general-internal-token", "planner-only-token")
	body := `{
      "planning_request_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
      "course_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
      "goal_code":"go.backend",
      "course_fingerprint":"fingerprint-v1",
      "planner_policy_version":"course-planner-v1",
      "reason_code":"initial_plan",
      "reason_summary":"Build a Go API",
      "expected_version":0,
      "items":[{"reference_type":"lesson","reference_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","position":0,"status":"READY","targets":[],"reason_code":"first_current_gap"}]
    }`
	request := httptest.NewRequest(
		http.MethodPut,
		"/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/learning-path",
		strings.NewReader(body),
	)
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "planner-only-token")
	request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK ||
		paths.input.PlanningRequestID != "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555" ||
		paths.input.IdempotencyKey != "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666" {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d input=%+v body=%s", response.Code, paths.input, response.Body.String())
	}
}

func TestReplaceLearningPathContextFencePair(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		fields string
		status int
	}{
		{``, 200},
		{`,"expected_onboarding_version":2,"expected_direction_code":"backend"`, 200},
		{`,"expected_onboarding_version":2`, 400},
		{`,"expected_direction_code":"backend"`, 400},
	} {
		paths := &learningPathHTTPStub{}
		router := NewRouter(&Handler{LearningPaths: paths}, "general-internal-token", "planner-only-token")
		request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPut, "/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/learning-path", strings.NewReader(`{"planning_request_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555","expected_version":0`+tc.fields+`}`))
		request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "planner-only-token")
		response := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
		if response.Code != tc.status {
			t.Fatalf("fields=%s status=%d body=%s", tc.fields, response.Code, response.Body.String())
		}
		if tc.status == 200 && tc.fields != "" && (paths.input.ExpectedOnboardingVersion != 2 || paths.input.ExpectedDirectionCode != "backend") {
			t.Fatalf("fence lost: %+v", paths.input)
		}
	}
}

func TestCompleteLearningPathRequiresDedicatedPlannerToken(t *testing.T) {
	completion := &learningPathCompletionHTTPStub{}
	handler := &Handler{LearningPathCompletion: completion}
	router := NewRouter(handler, "general-internal-token", "planner-only-token")
	path := "/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/learning-path/completion"
	body := `{
      "goal_code":"go.backend",
      "course_fingerprint":"fingerprint-v1",
      "planner_policy_version":"course-planner-v1",
      "reason_code":"mastery_no_gap",
      "reason_summary":"All required targets are mastered",
      "expected_version":3
    }`

	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name   string
		token  string
		status int
	}{
		{name: "general internal token", token: "general-internal-token", status: http.StatusForbidden},
		{name: "planner token", token: "planner-only-token", status: http.StatusOK},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPut, path, strings.NewReader(body))
			request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", testCase.token)
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
			if response.Code != testCase.status {
				t.Fatalf("status=%d want=%d body=%s", response.Code, testCase.status, response.Body.String())
			}
		})
	}
	if completion.input.StudentID != "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111" ||
		completion.input.CourseFingerprint != "fingerprint-v1" || completion.input.ExpectedVersion != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected completion command: %#v", completion.input)
	}
}
